comment: Each model is an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint. 'api_key_env' names the environment variable holding its key. Mix PROVIDERS (different lineages) for real diversity — that is what adds reasoning coverage, not more clones of one model. 'chair' must match one model 'name'. A model that fails or times out is skipped; the council proceeds as long as >=1 answers. Reasoning models can be slow — raise 'timeout_seconds' if one times out.
